scope: Identity-only freeze; no new issue, patch, trajectory, repository snapshot or criterion bodies read; no model calls or environment replay.
purpose: 24 confirmation candidates in 8 canonical repositories outside documented train/evaluation/reserved repositories. Actual environments remain unvalidated.

source.selection_bias: The existing local source is the upstream teacher-resolved split. No additional model-outcome filter was applied. This is not an unbiased sample of all real issues.

selection.repository_selection: Eight distinct namespaces with >=9 locally indexed PR identities, nonempty license metadata, full base commit and upstream image identifier, chosen before P017 model results as candidate CPU preparation work. Purposive repository sample, not random across all repositories.
selection.identity_order: SHA256(p017-confirmation-metadata-v1-20261024: + instance_id) ascending, then instance_id; retain first identity per repo/base_commit. No title, patch, difficulty, length or P017 outcome inspected.
selection.execution_order: Round robin repositories at rank 1, then rank 2, then rank 3.
selection.replacement: Before ANY C model results, use next frozen identity within same repository for inaccessible source or invalid environment/pre-post distinction; retain original failure and replacement. Whole-family failure reduces coverage; no unfrozen family substitution.
selection.family_boundary: Only case-normalized owner/repo identities checked. Local projection has no fork/rename ancestry; verify repository metadata before material admission. Genealogy independence is not yet proven.

overlap_audit.main_537_filter: native_sft_admitted == true and bucket == le16k in three SHA-verified constituent manifests
overlap_audit.identity_commit_conclusion: Repository-disjointness also excludes identical repository/issue and repository/base_commit pairs against these records; cross-name fork ancestry is unverified.

required_before_material_admission: Verify fork/rename ancestry using repository metadata; keep train/eval family exclusions.
Acquire only frozen eval identities from exact source revision, separated from training materials.
Resolve upstream image or reproduce pinned Linux environment. image_name is not proof of availability or successful replay.
Use upstream criteria for buggy F2P failure, reference F2P success and applicable P2P; preserve actual failures.
Freeze final material hashes and valid selection before any C model results.
